reason: The existing approved policy yields figure work during TSDF or large scoring, even with sufficient available memory. This proposal changes that rule only for the eight static figures in six_panel_v3.
authority_required: Explicit user approval to allow these bounded CPU-only figure stages during the protected postprocessing job.
postprocess_priority: Allow overlap only for the named static-figure stages. Record lock state, do not acquire or change the shared lock. Stop only this task's unique container below 24 GiB available; never modify or stop training/postprocessing.
on_oom: Stop this task and report; do not increase the limit without authorization.
risk: Caps bound this task's consumption but do not eliminate CPU, I/O or memory contention.
